data.narrative:
Comand AI is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Loïc Mougeolle and Antoine Chassan that has raised €11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparables universe of 10 peers spanning both public equities (2 companies: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private venture-backed firms (8 companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic).

The peer-median method was applied across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparable companies. UFORCE (seed stage) trades at $1.0B valuation, Singularity (Series A) at $400M, and NODA AI (Series A) at $125M. The median valuation across this set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This peer-median approach directly anchors the valuation given the limited data available at this stage and the relative homogeneity of the defense and security sector.

The triangulation analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), with a median point of $400M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single primary method. Key uncertainties include differentiation among seed-stage players in a capital-intensive sector, revenue traction relative to comparable firms at similar stages, and the degree to which public market multiples in defense technology transfer to private venture rounds. Further data on customer contracts, technical IP, and team composition would refine this range.
